'''Niorde''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of that [[Niorde system/Legends|same name]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

The planet was home to [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] called the [[Niordi]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Niordi were at war with a [[Niorde's rival planet|neighboring planet]] who hired members of the [[Leech Legion]]s to fight against the Noirdi. Some Niordi scouts including [[D'harhan]] became [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]] altered to become [[Niordi living weapon|living weapons]]. However, despite D'harhan and the others, Niorde fell to the Leech Legions.<ref name="TEGtW" />
